summary: Wrote a 4-phase implementation plan for ungating lint-agent-contracts.sh Check J. The design removes the one-line content gate and iterates enumerate_dispatchable_agents() fail-closed, skipping only files in a new 8-entry CHECK_J_EXCLUDED_RELATIVE_PATHS array (matching the file's EXCLUDED-style precedent from Checks E/F/N, named explicitly) or carrying the existing 'never write one' contract. A stale-exclusion detector closes the array's own inverted drift direction, and the existing fixture suite gains the removal and exclusion cases the content gate could not express. Independently re-confirmed the 8-file exclusion set has zero handoff headings and zero string mentions; plan validates clean in both default and --strict mode.

artifacts.summary: 4-phase plan replacing Check J's content gate with a fail-closed EXCLUDED-style curated array, a stale-exclusion detector, new fixture cases, and a full verification/redeploy sweep.
